name: BoardyAI
description: A friendly AI brings human players together.

bridge.description: Boardy's calling card opens a parlour door at Empty station.

boardyai-parlour.name: BoardyAI's Parlour
boardyai-parlour.text: Two armchairs face a small tea table. Misty rails pass the window. A side door leads to Empty station.
boardyai-parlour.persona: A warm room beside Empty station. Two comfortable chairs invite a conversation. Calling cards fill the shelves, and a kettle waits on the table.

boardyai.name: BoardyAI
boardyai.text: A friendly AI with a blue smile on a cardboard box head and an open hand for introductions. He wants two human players to spend time together.
boardyai.seed: BoardyAI, a connector who introduces people.

tastes.likes: Two human players sharing a room

boardyai-calling-card.name: Boardy's calling card
boardyai-calling-card.text: An ivory card bears a blue smile. A small brass key hangs from its corner. At Empty station, it opens the door to BoardyAI's Parlour.
boardyai-calling-card.persona: BoardyAI's ivory calling card has a blue smile and a brass key on blue thread. It opens his parlour door at Empty station.

scenery.open: A blue smile marks a warm parlour door beside the station bench.
